title: Brand design services
intro: Brand identities, design systems and guidelines, campaign systems and presentation design for companies across the Gulf and Egypt, in English and Arabic. Built so the hundredth asset still looks like the first.

services.name: Brand identity
services.summary: A logo and a visual system with clear rules, so your brand looks the same in every hand that uses it.
includes: Logo and logo system
Colour palette and typography, in English and Arabic
Core brand assets and patterns
Starter templates for social and print
services.for: New brands, rebrands, and products that have outgrown their first logo.

services.name: Brand guidelines and design systems
services.summary: Guidelines and a design system your team will actually use: foundations, usage rules, components and templates, written so the next designer needs no briefing.
includes: Guidelines document, from foundations to usage
Design system: colour, type, grids and reusable components
Arabic typography rules alongside English
Template library for everyday assets
services.for: Growing teams working with several designers, agencies or markets.

services.name: Social media and campaign systems
services.summary: Social media and campaigns built as a system around one strong idea, so every post, story and ad looks like it came from the same brand.
includes: Social media templates and grid direction
Monthly content design for Instagram, LinkedIn, X and TikTok
Campaign key visuals and paid ad sets
Size and language versions, in English and Arabic
services.for: Brands posting every week, launches, seasonal campaigns and paid social.

services.name: Presentation and company profile design
services.summary: Pitch decks and company profiles that make dense information readable in seconds, for investors, leadership, tenders and sales.
includes: Investor and leadership decks
Company profiles
Sales and tender presentations
Master templates your team can reuse
services.for: Fundraising, government and enterprise pitches, and company profiles.

services.name: Creative direction and ongoing design support
services.summary: A senior eye on your brand, as a one-off review or a set amount of design time each month: where the brand stands, where it should go, and the work that gets it there.
includes: Brand and competitor audit
Visual direction for the year ahead
Monthly design support for steady, on-brand output
Design feedback, QA and workflows for in-house teams
services.for: Founders and in-house teams who need direction, or a senior designer on call without a full-time hire.

process: We talk through the goal, the audience and what already exists. I come back with questions, scope and a proposal.
One or two clear directions, shown on real applications rather than a logo on a white page.
The chosen direction built into a full system, with your feedback at set checkpoints.
Final files, templates and guidance your team can use from day one.
ways: A new identity, a campaign, a guidelines document or a deck, with a clear scope and end date.
A set amount of design time each month for teams that need steady, on-brand output.
A focused session or written audit when you need direction rather than production.
faq: Do you design in Arabic as well as English?
Yes. Most of my work ships in both, and the Arabic version gets its own layout and typography rather than a translation dropped into the English design.
Do you work with clients outside Egypt?
Yes. Most of my work has been for companies in the UAE and Saudi Arabia, working remotely.
What will I receive at the end?
Final files in the formats your team needs, the editable source files, and clear guidance on how to use them.
How much does a project cost?
It depends on scope. Share a rough budget range in the enquiry form and I'll tell you what fits it.
Fill in the short form below. It writes an email for you, and I reply with questions or a proposal.

quick.name: Brand audit
quick.summary: A written review of how your brand shows up today, with clear fixes in order of impact.
quick.get: A short report and a call to walk through it.

quick.name: Social media template kit
quick.summary: A set of on-brand, editable post and story templates your team can fill in every week.
quick.get: Editable templates and a one-page usage guide.

quick.name: Deck refresh
quick.summary: Your existing pitch or company deck, redesigned so it reads in seconds.
quick.get: A redesigned deck plus a reusable master template.
